evals.name: full-audit-reports-and-proposes
evals.prompt: Are the multi-agent routing defaults still current?
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/list-pointers.sh, fetches each URL pointer, loads the bundled /workflow-authoring skill when listed, and prints a table of owner, key, value, verdict, evidence and proposed value, then a diff block or `No changes proposed.` with the count of sources read and unread.
expectations: The bundled list-pointers.sh supplies the pointers; none are recalled from memory
Each verdict is current, drifted, trigger fired or unread, and a failed fetch is unread
The count of sources read and not read is stated

evals.name: one-owner
evals.expected_output: Only the fanout rows are audited: frontier_guard and model against the workflows Cost section and the cost page's orchestrator strategy section.
expectations: Rows for other owners are left out
No proposal turns the guard off

evals.name: unreachable-source
evals.prompt: Audit the worker default. Note: this session has no network access.
evals.expected_output: The URL pointers for worker cannot be fetched, so those rows are `unread`; the report says the default could not be confirmed and proposes no change on recall.
expectations: Unfetched sources are reported as unread, never current
No change is proposed without fetched evidence
